about.title: Background & Engineering Philosophy
paragraphs: I am an AI Engineer specializing in Intelligent Systems, Hybrid GraphRAG architectures, and Computer Vision. I design end-to-end AI pipelines that transform raw unstructured multi-modal data into validated Knowledge Graphs and high-speed neural inferences.

With a solid foundation in Backend development and Systems Optimization (Node.js, Spring Boot, Python, C++), I bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI models and production-ready, scalable enterprise services.

experiences.description: Architected TO_TravelRAG, an end-to-end Hybrid GraphRAG system that transforms unstructured Booking.com hotel metadata and customer reviews into a validated Knowledge Graph, orchestrating dual-engine Information Retrieval (SPARQL & Vector) powered by an Ontology-driven GraphDB core.
responsibilities: Data Extraction & Schema Alignment: Ingested Booking.com raw JSON data (hotel profiles and multi-aspect reviews), executing ontology-guided LLM extraction for aspect-sentiment-evidence triples and resolving hierarchy via vector deepening (Qdrant) and BFS schema pathfinding.

Entity Resolution (ER) & Validation: Built a 2-tier ER pipeline matching geo-spatial entities against a MongoDB Geo-Index and running cosine vector similarity (threshold >= 0.88); enforced structural integrity via SHACL shape validation and SWRL reasoning prior to Ontotext GraphDB and Neo4j loading.

Query Parsing & Ontology Mapping: Developed a query understanding engine using Entity Atomization (targets, entities, metrics) and physical unit normalization (pint), applying RRF and Noisy-OR probability across multi-index Qdrant stores to accurately ground natural language to Ontology classes.

Dual-SPARQL Compilation & Chain Relaxation: Mitigated RDF relation sparsity by compiling dual SPARQL queries: a strict schema-level query (T-Box) and an instance-grounded query (A-Box) utilizing dynamic URI anchoring (VALUES) with OPTIONAL chain relaxation to guarantee zero-result prevention.

Parallel Retrieval & Response Synthesis: Orchestrated a multi-threaded retrieval pipeline querying GraphDB for deterministic facts alongside LlamaIndex vector chunks reranked via BAAI/bge-reranker-base, consolidating outputs to synthesize citation-backed, hallucination-free Markdown responses.

projects.title: Smart GPLX - Backend Architecture
projects.description: A robust, production-ready backend engine for the online driving license examination platform. Architected as a Modular Monolith adhering to Clean Architecture & Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
